product.title: Sacred Adventure at Xenotes! 4 Different Cenotes + Round Transportation

description.text: In Cancun, this Xenotes day follows the Ruta de los Cenotes into jungle sinkholes of four types: semi-open, open, ancient, and cavern. Round-trip hotel transport is included, and the circuit mixes rappelling, zip lining, kayaking, and swimming before a picnic lunch with water, coffee, wine, and beer. Stops include Ruta de los Cenotes, Semi-open cenote, Open cenote, Ancient cenote, Cavern cenote. Life jackets and activity gear are provided so visitors can stay with the water rather than packing their own kit. The format suits visitors basing in Cancun who want a full cenote circuit without coordinating four separate park tickets. Departures are confirmed at booking in Cancun, and the itinerary stays on the published Xenotes route rather than adding extra ruins or beach clubs.
